open.title: Apify config + 0600 credential needed; rss-reader is built and tested offline, ready for a private build
open.detail: Still missing: a valid enabled Apify configuration and a private Apify credential file with mode 0600. Ready now: products/actors/rss-reader passed 22/22 real offline tests (products/actors/rss-reader/core-test-results.json), including the saved github.blog feed (10 items), Atom, RSS 1.0/2.0, XXE/billion-laughs refusal, timeout and bounded reads. Its Apify SDK wrapper is untested until a private build runs. csv-preflight stays parked (demand verdict DO_NOT_PURSUE). After access: private PUBLISH_ACTOR rss-reader with item-parsed=1000 and apify-actor-start=50 micro-USD, a real run on https://github.blog/feed/, then an independent APPROVE of the exact digest before public listing. Kill if fewer than 3 external users within 14 days.
open.expected_gain: First Apify pay-per-event listing (rss-reader). Incumbents have 39-51 users_30d; revenue unverified and uncertain.
